name: Syncthing
description: Syncthing's state in the bar and a panel for folders (rescan, pause, share), devices, invitations, recent file activity and the user service, through its REST API on this machine (haseen syncthing). Adapted from ilyaZar's omarchy-syncthing (MIT). Off by default

refreshIntervalSec.description: While Syncthing is not answering, ask again at most this often (seconds, 60 or more); while it runs, its own events drive every update

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.syncthing (state) from the service
